definition: One counted result per configured model/effort combination, under the existing scoring and timeout policy; not 20 repetitions and not a claim of nine uninterrupted completions.
held_or_superseded_revisions: Separate validity context; not silently merged into the current 99-cell grid.
limitations: Nine first results per task are a coverage grid, not a reliable per-cell pass-rate estimate.
Two first-result cells have specifically audited gateway/quota interruptions; remaining timeouts and censored costs stay visible.
Paired verifier regrades and later counted repetitions are not new first-result cells.
report_authorship: Factual report-support material. The supplied human-authored report remains a separate deliverable.
user_request: Include all selected tasks with at least one full sweep in the report.
